messages:
product-lead: Heads-up: Hosted ToolFlow v1 is GA for structured tool-calling + adaptive streaming. This release exposes `toolflow-v1` (schema-enforced tool outputs), `stream-adapt` (chunked streaming with adaptive chunk sizes), and the `toolflow.stream` endpoint for interleaved tool calls + token stream. Internal docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/toolflow-ga (internal).

product-lead: TL;DR: 1) SDKs (py/js) include new `toolflow` namespace. 2) New console pages: Console -> Features -> ToolFlow (schema, examples, QA). 3) Pricing: per-tool-invocation + stream surcharge; early adopters get fee waiver for 30 days. 4) Old endpoint `/v1/streamtool` will be deprecated in 120 days; 45-day auto-forwarding available.

eng-arch: For engineers: tool outputs now support JSON-schema enforcement + typed function results. We also added output provenance headers (x-rdwd-tool-latency, x-rdwd-schema-match). If a response fails schema validation, the call returns 422 with schema errors and a structured error payload.

devx: Migration snippets: python (minimal):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
# new: schema + streaming
resp = c.toolflow.stream(model='toolflow-v1', input='Analyze doc...', schema={'type':'object','props':{'summary':{'type':'string'}}}, stream=True)
for ev in resp:
    if ev.type == 'tool_result':
        handle(ev.result)
```
JS example (old -> new):
```js
// old: client.streamTool.create({model, input})
// new: client.toolflow.stream({model: 'toolflow-v1', input, schema: {...}})
```
Note: minor SDK bump; no breaking auth changes.

legal: Quick note: tool outputs may be stored for quality + eval by default. Policy: Hosted ToolFlow preserves tooling metadata for 90 days; customers can request extended retention via contract. If you surface partner-specific telemetry, check with security/compliance.

ops-lead: Canary plan: infra-bot scheduled canary at 2106003600 -> rollout 5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100% over 8h. Canary keys under secrets/toolflow/canary/*; request via infra ticket. Rollback plan included in runbook.

infra-bot: infra-deploy-bot: Canary started=2106003600, stage=5%->25%->75%->100% (~8h), rollback-window=3h. Signal hooks: model-errors, schema-fail-rate, stream-latency-p95.

analytics: Observability: new dashboards in Console -> Models -> toolflow-v1: p50/p95/p99 latency, schema-match-rate, tool-invocation-per-call, stream-throughput. Also added sample trace spans for tool resolution.

eng-arch: Important opcode: adaptive streaming will try 40-200ms chunk targets depending on client RTT and prefix-cache hits. Default chunk target is 100ms; tunable via `stream_hint` in requests.

product-lead: Pricing and billing: early-adopter waiver for 30 days, then per-tool-call cents + per-stream-second microcharge. Billing details will appear in the Console pricing page tomorrow. Customers can opt out of streaming charges by disabling `stream=true` or using batched `toolflow.batch`.

devx: SDKs will emit deprecation warnings for `/v1/streamtool` in logs starting 45 days before cutover. We'll push a patch with console banner integration to show customers who still use the old endpoint.

legal: Reminder to reps: update contract addenda for Dedicated / Private deployments that require no retention or alternate IP terms. Contact counsel for template.

ops-lead: Launch call + ops readout tomorrow 11:00 PT. Runbook + rollback checklist posted in #release-war-room. Please RSVP if you're leading monitoring or support.

product-lead: Thanks everyone. Massive props to eng-arch/infra/devx/ops/analytics/legal for getting this over the line. If you see anything odd in the first 24h, ping @ops-lead directly. :rocket:
